personal.name: Vaishal S
personal.tagline: Making technology invisible, one solution at a time
personal.subtitle: ERP Intern → Freelance IT Support → MNC Professional
personal.bio:
I've spent four and a half years making technology work seamlessly for people—from ERP implementations that taught me how business systems work, to freelance support solving real-world problems, to now supporting global clients at an MNC.

I believe good support isn't just about closing tickets—it's about clear communication and making someone's day easier. When I'm not troubleshooting infrastructure, you'll find me tinkering with hardware or hiking trails.

aboutNarrative.intro: My journey in tech started with curiosity and evolved into a passion for solving problems that matter.

journey.description: As an ERP Support Intern, I learned how enterprise systems power entire organizations. This taught me to see beyond individual tickets to understand business impact.
Going freelance was a leap of faith. Supporting multiple clients across industries sharpened my ability to adapt quickly, communicate clearly, and deliver reliable solutions under pressure.

Now at an MNC, I apply everything I've learned to support global clients. The stakes are higher, the systems more complex, but the core mission remains: make technology invisible so people can focus on what matters.

aboutNarrative.values: I bring a unique blend of hands-on technical skills, business awareness from ERP systems, and the client-first mindset developed through freelancing. I don't just fix problems—I prevent them, document solutions, and empower users.
